name: Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero
notes: Primary game story preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse. Besides Bi-Han's pre-tournament history, it says Shang Tsung bargained with Quan Chi for Shinnok's help tainting Sindel's soul and reincarnating her on Earth so Shao Kahn could cross the dimensional gates and overtake Earth; the scheme would take more than a decade to accomplish.
